text:
incident-bot: Pager fired: p99 latency > 2.0s for service=redwood-inference-api region=eu-west. PagerDuty: https://pd.example/incidents/PD12345 :rotating_light:

pagerduty-bot: Incident PD12345 assigned to maya (ack required).

maya: acked. looking. any obvious noisy keys? :eyes:

sam: seeing a sudden spike in tail latency on the inference sidecars, correlates with batch size upswing from a recent release. no 5xx yet, just >2s token latency.

leo: visual: Grafana p99 jumped to 2.8s around 11:42 UTC, p95 at ~1.1s. throughput steady.

ciara: paging the infra team to scale the dedicated pool while we triage. @ops-runner can you spin up a couple nodes?

ops-runner: on it. running `./infra scale --pool inference-eu-west --delta 2` (will be up in ~90s).

maya: good. also temp-reroute low-priority traffic to fallback model (quantized v1) to reduce pressure. adding rule now.

sam: pushed routing change: `route.set("inference-api", {fallback: "model-v1-quant", pct: 30})` — monitoring.

leo: confirming KV cache hit rate dropped slightly (~3%) at spike start; might be cache warmness after release. warming prefixes for high-qps keys now with a synthetic pre-populate job.

ciara: customer impact check: no major customer errors reported, some increased TTFB for a subset of calls (estimated ~4% of active sessions exceed 2s). flagging product for notification if it stays beyond 30m.

maya: infra nodes healthy, new capacity registered. p99 dropped to 1.9s after scale + reroute. still watching. :thumbsup:

sam: rolling back the batch config from 64->48 for the short term (`config: batching.max_tokens=48`) to reduce head-of-line.

ops-runner: scale complete and autoscaler logs look normal; no OOMs.

leo: after batch rollback and reroute p99 now 1.4s, p95 steady at ~0.9s. looks stable for last 2 mins.

maya: great. leaving PD incident open for 15 more mins for follow-up. will create post-mortem stub and update runbook re: warmup and batch thresholds.

ciara: noted for customer comms if threshold crosses again. assigning follow-ups: @sam to add guardrail to release pipeline (block batch config > 56 without perf test). @leo to add KV warmup job in canary rollout. @ops-runner to add capacity alert to detect saturating queues before latency rises.

pagerduty-bot: PD12345 status updated: acknowledged by maya, assigned to eng-oncall.

maya: handing off to leo for next shift check. leaving note: recovery via scale + reroute + batch rollback. will sync in rotation handoff doc.

leo: taking it, watching for 30m. thanks all. :coffee:
